title: Feedback API & Form
description: Build an API endpoint that stores feedback and a frontend form to submit it.
problemStatement:
## Goal
Create a simple feedback system using API routes and a form.

### Requirements
1. Create an API route at `pages/api/feedback.js`.
   - On `GET`, return a JSON array of feedback messages (hardcoded or in‑memory array).
   - On `POST`, read the JSON body `{ message }`, add it to the array, and return `{ success: true }`.
   - For POST, parse the body manually using the `req.on('data', ...)` method.
2. Create a page at `pages/feedback.js`.
   - Include a `<textarea>` and a submit button.
   - On button click, send a POST to `/api/feedback` with the message.
   - Display a success message after submission.
   - Also fetch the existing feedback on mount (GET) and display as a list.
3. Test: submit a message, see it added to the list.

### Note
Data persists only in memory; it will reset on server restart. That's fine for learning.
hints: For body parsing: use a Promise and `req.on('data')` and `req.on('end')`. Remember to parse JSON.
Manage state with `useState` for the feedback list and input.
expectedOutput: A working feedback form that submits and displays messages.
